# T-1: Update artifact contracts

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Extend schemas and validators so test-execute, test-result-review, retro, and final-regression can represent no-tests states without weakening failure handling.

## Acceptance Criteria
- test-execute-result schema and validator accept summary result=not_applicable with reason=no_tests_declared.
- final-regression validation accepts skipKind=skipped_by_project_policy only for skipped artifacts with command-discovery proof.
- invalid failure artifacts and malformed no-tests artifacts remain rejected.

## Implementation Notes
Keep v2 as the current contract. Avoid compatibility branches for legacy shapes. Prefer shared validator helpers in src/flow/lib/test-artifacts.js over duplicated enum checks.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for validators and schema edge cases, including valid no-tests artifacts and invalid malformed artifacts.
